# Thorcast.AI

> AI predictive analytics for banks, insurers, telcos and retailers worldwide: credit scoring, churn, fraud and geo intelligence models built on enriched data, in minutes rather than months.

Thorcast.AI is a platform where AI agents take a predictive model from raw data to production: NORA prepares and joins the data, MJÖ builds and compares models autonomously, and the platform handles data enrichment, Champion–Challenger comparison, batch scoring, monitoring and recalibration. Models are explainable and documented for audit. Thorcast.AI serves organizations in any region: the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia.

## Solutions

- [AI credit scoring](https://thorcast.ai/ai-credit-scoring.html): credit scoring models with AI and alternative data for origination, collections, payment agreements and cutoff decisions. Also in [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/scoring-crediticio-ia.html) and [Portuguese](https://thorcast.ai/credit-scoring-com-ia.html).
- [Customer churn model](https://thorcast.ai/customer-churn-prediction-model.html): churn prediction for banking, telco, life insurance and general insurance, measured against a fixed contact capacity. Also in [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/modelo-churn-fuga-clientes.html) and [Portuguese](https://thorcast.ai/modelo-de-churn-clientes.html).
- [Fraud detection with machine learning](https://thorcast.ai/fraud-detection-machine-learning.html): application fraud, account takeover, health claims fraud and improper motor claim payments. Also in [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/deteccion-fraude-machine-learning.html) and [Portuguese](https://thorcast.ai/deteccao-de-fraude-machine-learning.html).
- [Geographic intelligence](https://thorcast.ai/geographic-intelligence.html): block-level area profiles, points of interest and travel-time zones for geomarketing, expansion, networks and territorial risk. Also in [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/inteligencia-geografica.html) and [Portuguese](https://thorcast.ai/inteligencia-geografica-com-ia.html).

## Guides

- [How to choose credit scoring software](https://thorcast.ai/how-to-choose-credit-scoring-software.html): buyer's guide: five types of credit scoring tools, ten evaluation criteria, how to run a fair proof of concept, red flags, decision layers, and where Thorcast fits and does not. Also in [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/como-elegir-software-scoring-crediticio.html) and [Portuguese](https://thorcast.ai/como-escolher-software-de-credit-scoring.html).
- [How to predict customer churn in banking, insurance and telco](https://thorcast.ai/how-to-predict-customer-churn-banking-insurance-telco.html): defining churn per industry, predictive data, measuring a model against a fixed contact capacity, value-based retention and decision layers. Also in [Spanish](https://thorcast.ai/como-predecir-churn-banca-seguros-telco.html) and [Portuguese](https://thorcast.ai/como-prever-churn-bancos-seguros-telecom.html).
